summaries.cfd61be9-da05-49f5-ba93-5d62df3862da: Braylen Yates finished 8th at 175 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 with a 6-3 record. He beat Sean Breedlove, a #23 Sports Illustrated-ranked 2026 IN State Champion, 4-1; Brock Armstrong, a #28 Sports Illustrated-ranked 2x 2026 ID 6A State Champion, 4-1; Joel Welch, a #11 MatScouts-ranked 2026 OH Division II State Champion, by medical forfeit; and Teag Sanderson, a 2026 PA AAA State 3rd, 4-1. Yates lost to Maximus Fortier, a 3x WV State Champion and 2026 Super 32 runner-up; Kyler Crooks, a 2026 OH Division III State Champion and 2026 Super 32 6th; and Ibrahim Dheel, the 2026 VA 6A State Runner-up and 2026 Super 32 7th.
summaries.63c10af0-86f1-49f6-849f-05da975dba9b: Liam Smith went 1-2 at 190 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place. He beat Charlie Wright of NC by fall in 2:51. Smith lost to David Clayton of PA, a 2026 PA AAA State 8th and 2025 NHSCA All-American (8th, 182), by medical forfeit.
summaries.cb19d9e6-c779-478b-954f-939bd818250a: Lauren Samuel finished 3rd at 132 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 with a 7-1 record. She beat Kailin Sebert of Texas, a #4 MatScouts-ranked wrestler, 2x state champion, and 2024 Super 32 Girls Champion, by VSU 11-0 in 1:45; Victoria Carbonaro of New Jersey, #7 MatScouts and 2024 Super 32 Girls 3rd at 124, by VPO1 12-3; Rachel Garcia of Oklahoma, #3 MatScouts and 2026 Super 32 Girls 5th at 132, by VFA 5-2 in 1:58; and Olivia Bezdicek of Idaho, #5 MatScouts and 2x state champion, by VSU 10-0 in 2:13. Samuel lost to Mila Mantanona of California, the 2026 Super 32 Girls 6th at 132, by VPO1 7-7.
summaries.6020b56d-982d-48db-b191-c737388094fb: Ella Taylor went 4-1 to finish 3rd at 200 pounds at the 2026 Super 32. She beat Kenzie Barrett, a 2026 FL FHSAA State Champion and #9 MatScouts (235), 9-4; Autumn King, 2026 Super 32 Girls 4th (200) and #14 Sports Illustrated (207), 5-0; Blake Baker, 2025 TX 6A State 4th and 2026 Super 32 Girls 7th (200), by fall; and Delina Gritz, 2026 NY State 4th and 2026 Super 32 Girls 6th (200), 8-4. Her loss was to Zeinab Mourad, the 2026 FL FHSAA State Runner-up and 2026 Super 32 Girls Champion (200).
summaries.35b27447-8db5-4aea-a4b7-c5e62d557010: Bella Johnson went 1-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 112 pounds and did not place. She beat Caelyn Kish of NC by technical fall, 10-0 in 1:01. Johnson lost to Brooke Dixon of CT by decision, 4-0, and to Jayleigh Rex of PA by fall.
summaries.8bf9019b-fd66-43d7-b7d1-e2d83dae0ded: Cooper Mathon went 1-2 without placing at the 2026 Super 32 at 132 pounds. His win was a 10-9 decision over Lincoln Glennon, a 2025 PA Open State 4th. Mathon lost by technical fall to Robert Ruscitti, the 2026 IL 3A State 5th.
summaries.5d23aaab-11ee-4610-a54f-db70aae033c5: Kate Hayes went 1-2 with no place at the 2026 Super 32 at 132 pounds. She beat Kaydence Olivares of NC, VPO1 8-2, and lost to Gianna Montegari of PA, a 2026 PA State 3rd, VPO 4-0.
summaries.efa17439-9fcf-4a79-acf9-af83ba23472b: Tyler Saintal went 1-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 157 pounds and did not place. He beat Worth Wilson of NC by decision, 17-12. He lost to Will LaVallee, a 2026 MA All-State 4th, by technical fall, 17-0.
summaries.f5a87c74-7dc6-427c-b205-da34e24c2375: Xavier Bernthal went 1-2 at 126 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place. He beat Jonathan Toriello of Connecticut by major decision, 12-4. Bernthal lost to Jack Stonebraker of Pennsylvania, who is ranked #27 by Sports Illustrated at 120, by fall.
summaries.a045087f-22be-466d-a4f5-81fc8d5cdd5c: Aaron Ruiz-Angel went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 215 pounds. He lost to Colton Bell of Florida, a two-time NHSCA All-American and 2026 Super 32 fifth-place finisher, by fall, and to Hunter Baker of Georgia, the 2026 GA 3A State fifth-place finisher, by decision.
summaries.c1849e65-a453-4506-b6d3-96f7423a25c9: Cade Gehris went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 157 pounds and did not place at the tournament. He lost to Cameron Cooper of Indiana by major decision, 13-0, and to Austin Owen of Alabama by medical forfeit; Owen is a 2026 Alabama 7A State 3rd-place finisher.
summaries.c1e69c1e-2615-4027-9e11-9ced59b3085e: Casey Dixon went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place at the tournament. She lost to Camilla Hathaway of Pennsylvania, a 2026 PA State 3rd, 2026 Super 32 Girls 6th (160), and 2024 Super 32 Girls 3rd (138), and to Hannah Crowe of Georgia, a 2026 GA State 4th.
summaries.6bb63666-61cd-4933-a9b6-34cfc59bdd84: Cayden Laws went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 138 pounds. He lost to Calan Manley of Oklahoma, a 2026 OK 6A State 4th and 2026 NHSCA All-American (4th at 138), by technical fall. Laws also lost to Salvador Bautista of California by fall.
summaries.eb3ce001-65a2-4335-8b58-a83c6aed6be5: Connor Brinkley went 0-2 with no place at the 2026 Super 32 at 285 pounds. He lost to Nolan Reinert of Pennsylvania, a 2026 PA AAA State 4th, by fall (10-0, 2:33), and dropped a 7-1 decision to Henry Redman of Indiana.
summaries.ad496fe2-c502-478d-b573-20c5ec4c7048: Danny Ross II went 0-2 at 126 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place at the tournament. He lost to Chase Phillips of NY, a 2026 NY D1 State 5th, by fall, and to Keegan Barrick of PA by technical fall.
summaries.834f8859-c8a2-4793-b17d-6aea29fe5453: Dylan Welch went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 144 pounds and did not place at the tournament. He lost to Jacob Fletcher of South Carolina by technical fall and to Logan Miller of Florida by major decision.
summaries.c4eb49fe-6b31-4f19-a129-9ace1d17c76e: Jacobie Morrison went 0-2 at 120 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place at the tournament. He lost to Nick Payne of Texas by major decision, 12-0, and to Kaden Haakinson of Minnesota by major decision, 13-1.
summaries.75f3096f-2cde-4a4d-a20a-e347affca321: Kellen Gue went 0-2 with no place at the 2026 Super 32 at 106 pounds. He lost to Dandre Adams of Texas by 3-0 decision and to Jaxon Flood of Florida by 20-4 technical fall.
summaries.d1b5dca0-2b62-4247-96d1-81a8a609f352: Mia Pardo went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 95 pounds and did not place at the tournament. She lost to Mackenzie Amidon of California, who finished seventh at 95 pounds at the 2026 Super 32, and to Alexandra Thomas of Florida.
summaries.2b877ced-4b7e-4ed7-ac4d-d93db1f53de6: Nat Dolan went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 106 pounds and did not place. She lost to Nevaeh Colon of Pennsylvania, a 2025 PA State 7th, by fall, and to Serra Akyali of New York by technical superiority.
summaries.63ff501c-5c84-4f2f-b594-aad0a9c79baa: Ryan Johnson went 0-2 at 106 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place. He lost to Quinn Bagnell, the 2026 PA AAA State 6th, 11-0, and to Charlie Atkinson of Connecticut, 4-1.
summaries.b2586489-a8b9-4251-9e35-356e8ff813f4: Savada Kitchen went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 200 pounds. She lost to Lyla Hensen, the 2026 Super 32 Girls 2nd place finisher at 200, by 10-0 VSU, and to Autumn King, the 2026 Super 32 Girls 4th place finisher at 200, by VFA.
summaries.1f0707f1-990d-4916-a54e-2a88f62c73e9: Veronika Wilson went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 124 pounds. She lost to Olive Lechiara of California, a 2026 CA State 7th, by VPO 8-0, and to Sayria Jeter of Virginia by VSU1 14-4 in 3:49.
summaries.477fe710-4949-404b-b8a7-97d5a4c90cec: Worth Wilson went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 157 pounds and did not place at the tournament. He lost by technical fall to Terriel Cooke of Florida and by decision to Tyler Saintal of North Carolina.
summaries.4be1dbae-4564-43b1-8a9d-f504d5a54d8f: Zachary Cotter went 0-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 157 pounds and did not place at the tournament. He lost by technical fall to Coehn Weber of Illinois, a 2026 IL 3A State 4th, and to Blake Fry of Pennsylvania.
